scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n client,server "bun run --cwd apps/client dev" "bun run --cwd apps/server start:dev"
scripts.build: bun run --cwd apps/client build && bun run --cwd apps/server build
scripts.start: bun run --cwd apps/client start && bun run --cwd apps/server start:prod
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run check:client
